title: kit.kit-head-registry.v1
description: packages/core/registry/kit-head.json: where the kit's main head (kit.kit-head.v1) is published and read. url is null until the public object exists; a site's vendor check then fails closed in CI.

bucket.description: The kit owner's bucket (its name carries the owner project's prefix, checked against the project registry by the naming rules)

archive_key.description: The key of the published archive of a head, {sha} replaced by the commit: published beside the head object, named by it (kit.kit-head.v1 archive).
